description: Read the Markdown body of one note, by id. Get ids from search_notes or list_notes first. A long note comes in parts: the first ends by saying where the next begins and where each heading (each chapter, say) starts, so pass `start` to read the part wanted. Password-locked notes cannot be read: unlocking is something a browser does, and this connection has no way to do it.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

start.description: Where to start reading, as a character position. Omit it to start at the beginning. A note too long for one reply ends by giving the start of the next part and of every heading, so a chapter can be read without reading everything before it.

name: scratchpad_read_note
title: Read note
